return `INV-${year}-${paddedCounter}`;
+ * Calculate the next credit note number for a given date.
+ * @param {Array<string>} existingNumbers - All existing numbers (invoices and credit notes)
+ * @param {string} issueDate - Date in YYYY-MM-DD format
+ * @returns {string} Next credit note number in format CN-YYYY-NNNN
+export function nextCreditNoteNumber(existingNumbers, issueDate) {
+  const year = issueDate.split('-')[0];
+  // Filter to CN numbers from this year and extract counters
+  const thisYearCounters = existingNumbers
+    .map((num) => {
+      const match = /^CN-(\d{4})-(\d{4})$/.exec(num);
+      return match && match[1] === year ? parseInt(match[2], 10) : null;
+    .filter((n) => n !== null);
+  // Find max counter, or 0 if none exist
+  const maxCounter = thisYearCounters.length > 0 ? Math.max(...thisYearCounters) : 0;
+  // Return next number
+  const nextCounter = maxCounter + 1;
+  const paddedCounter = String(nextCounter).padStart(4, '0');
+  return `CN-${year}-${paddedCounter}`;
